title: dryopteris penangiana
intro: Dryopteris penangiana, commonly known as the Penang shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of medicinal plant that has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris penangiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to reduce oxidative stress, improve immune function, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
